title: Smooth duality: the dualizing complex is an invertible sheaf in degree -2d
statement: Let $f\colon X\to Y$ be a smooth separated morphism of pure relative dimension $d$ [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms] admitting a compactification [def-asd-compactifiable], and let $\Lambda$ be a finite commutative ring whose exponent is invertible on $X$. Put $\omega_f=Rf^!\Lambda_Y$ [lem-sf-etale-ambient-adjoint-projection] in $D(X_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ [def-weil-pbc-derived-categories]. Then there is a locally constant sheaf $L$ of $\Lambda$-modules on $X_{\mathrm{et}}$ [def-constructible-locally-constant] whose stalk at every geometric point (with separably closed residue field) is isomorphic to $\Lambda$, with $\omega_f\cong L[2d]$; and for every $K\in D(Y_{\mathrm{et}},\Lambda)$ the canonical map $\theta_{f,K}\colon\omega_f\otimes^Lf^*K\to Rf^!K$ [def-kun-derived-tensor] is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Identify sfEtaleAmbientTensorMap for the chosen compactification and rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction with dualizingComplexTensorMap. Unfold the two transposes and move the derived left unitor inside homEquiv by homEquiv_naturality_right; associativity gives equality. For any other compactification of a quasi-compact morphism, transport the same adjunction along rightDerivedLowerShriekIso. The already proved projectionMapOfCompactification_rightDerivedLowerShriekOfCompactificationIso equation, inverted and composed with the transported counit, cancels both comparison components. Thus the actual tensor maps agree, rather than merely their sources and targets being isomorphic. Quasi-compactness is used only later for the affine-line projection.

proof.text: Choose the positive annihilator N supplied by HasInvertibleExponent on an affine base S. Its global unit maps to a unit in every stalk of S and, via the projection stalk maps, in every stalk of the affine line. Apply finite_etale_torsion_twist_line at twist 1. Its local module-sheaf trivializations give locally constant. To obtain the rank-one assertion at an arbitrary separably closed geometric point, choose a cover member over its image, lift the geometric point by exists_comp_eq_of_etale, transport the localized-site trivialization through overSheafEquiv, and compose upperStarCompSheafFiberIso, the image of that trivialization, uliftSheafFiberIso and sheafFiberUnitIso. This also works for the zero ring; for an empty scheme the stalk assertion is vacuous.

proof.text: Apply sfAffineLineCanonicalDuality to its explicit standard compactification, with G equal to the actual upper-shriek functor and adj the transported actual adjunction. The returned gamma presents its dualizing complex as the concrete Tate line shifted by 2. Step 3 supplies the local constancy and rank-one stalks. Each gamma tensor identity is invertible; cancel it from the returned invertible composite and use step 1 to obtain invertibility of the actual canonical tensor map. This proves the AffineLineSmoothDuality interface.

Its affineSpaceSmoothDuality_of_affineLineSmoothDuality proves the affine-space case by coordinate splitting and induction; its Charts theorem uses the source coefficient unit locus, smooth etale normal form and relative dimension d, then composes with the target open immersion and descends along source open charts. These existing proofs retain the unit route and apply over arbitrary schemes, including empty sources.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_dualizingComplex_iso_and_tensor :
    ∃ L : Sheaf X.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ), IsLocallyConstantSheaf L ∧
      (∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsSepClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ X),
        Nonempty ((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber.obj L ≅ ModuleCat.of Λ Λ)) ∧
      Nonempty (dualizingComplex (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ) f ≅
        ((_root_.DerivedCategory.singleFunctor _ 0).obj L)⟦(2 * d : ℤ)⟧) ∧
      ∀ K : _root_.DerivedCategory (Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{u + 1} Λ)),
        IsIso (dualizingComplexTensorMap Λ f K) :=
  sorry
